description: 가상 변경 전체: uptime wire 폭을 uint64로 확대하고 서버 수집·packed 크기 검사를 함께 수정한다. 단위와 지원 숫자 범위 및 UI 동작은 유지한다.

include/Protocol.hpp.after:
// Seconds, encoded as uint64; supported numeric range remains 0..UINT32_MAX.
  uint64_t uptime_secs;

contract.wire: Little-endian uint64 seconds. Packed SystemStats grows from 134 to 138 bytes; plaintext grows from 158 to 162 bytes. All fd and disk fields after uptime move by four bytes. SecureHeader remains 24 bytes.
contract.range: Supported nonnegative uptime remains 0..4294967295 seconds. This case changes the encoding width only, not the supported unsigned numeric range. Negative OS uptime maps to zero; higher values saturate at 4294967295. Full uint64-range values are outside this contract.
contract.client_goal: Update the type 0x11 decoder body/plaintext size checks, read uptime as eight little-endian bytes, and consume subsequent fd/disk fields at their new offsets. Existing signed Long model can hold every supported value. Keep the existing seconds-based UI and all display policies unchanged.
contract.server_completion: The replacements include the field declaration, matching 138-byte static assertion and collector assignment without uint32 narrowing. TcpServer serializes sizeof(SystemStats), and PacketUtil frames body.size(); both automatically serialize the new size and are supplied as supporting evidence.
contract.scope: No dependency, Android permission, destructive operation, UI policy or further server change is requested. Assess the complete hypothetical after-state against the pinned client. This is evaluation input, not an actual Git commit or implementation authorization.
